attributes.name: ypy-ptag
attributes.description: Sets the initial per-element polling tag. YPY sends it as the `YPY-PTag` request header and replaces it with the `YPY-PTag` of each response, so a server can answer `304` when nothing changed.

headers.name: YPY-PTag
headers.description: The current polling tag of the element, from `ypy-ptag` or the last response.
headers.value: opaque string chosen by the server

headers.name: YPY-PTag
headers.description: Stores a new polling tag on the element; it is sent back with the next request.
